His music, rooted in bhakti (devotion), continues to inspire countless people, emphasizing the power of chanting to connect with the divine and achieve inner peace.

snippet.description:
Which is tougher: NEET or UPSC? AIR 170 Abhijeet Jain presents an interesting perspective on the competition in both examinations. Comparing the number of candidates, serious competition and the ranks needed to secure a seat at AIIMS, he explains why he considers NEET more challenging in certain ways. He also questions the common perception that UPSC is automatically the tougher examination. Watch his take on how competition and rank requirements change the way we look at these exams.
